args.sql:
SELECT
    t2.credscore AS credit_category,
    t1.clientref AS customer_id,
    t1.agespan AS age,
    t1.gendlabel AS gender,
    t1.maritalform AS marital_status,
    t1.depcount AS dependent_count,
    t1.resdform AS residential_status,
    t1.addrstab AS address_stability,
    t1.phonestab AS phone_stability,
    t1.emailstab AS email_stability,
    t1.clientseg AS customer_segment,
    t1.tenureyrs AS tenure_years,
    t1.crossratio AS cross_sell_ratio,
    t1.profitscore AS profitability_score,
    t1.churnrate AS churn_rate
FROM
    core_record AS t1
JOIN
    credit_and_compliance AS t2
ON
    t1.coreregistry = t2.compbankref
GROUP BY
    credit_category,
    customer_id,
    age,
    gender,
    marital_status,
    dependent_count,
    residential_status,
    address_stability,
    phone_stability,
    email_stability,
    customer_segment,
    tenure_years,
    cross_sell_ratio,
    profitability_score,
    churn_rate;
